name: Waldorf Astoria Cancun

address.street: Carretera Federal Libre 307 Cancun-Tulum 248+868 SM-36 MZ-1

insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on 100 acres of pristine Mayan coastline, where ancient cenotes meet crystalline Caribbean waters.
whats_special: The resort features an exclusive 18-hole championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus, plus access to natural underground cenotes perfect for snorkeling. Its signature restaurant helmed by a Michelin-starred chef showcases elevated Mexican cuisine using ingredients from the hotel's own organic garden.
pro_tip: Book the Cenote Cave Dinner experience - a private meal served in an ancient limestone cave illuminated by candles, available only to hotel guests.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views of both the Caribbean Sea and Nichupté Lagoon, and the exclusive turtle nesting experience during season (May-October) where guests can witness sea turtles laying eggs on the resort's protected beach.
pros: Legendary Waldorf Astoria luxury service and hospitality standards
Prime beachfront location on Cancun's pristine Caribbean coastline
World-class spa and wellness facilities with premium treatments
Multiple fine dining restaurants featuring international and local cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
May be less suitable for budget-conscious travelers
